verdict.rationale: Jeeves publishes an official MCP server at its docs site, and a probe confirms the page exists. It lets AI assistants and autonomous agents query and export transactions, review balances, manage and issue virtual cards, handle reimbursements, and pay vendors and bills. Missing for 10: documented connection and setup details (transport, endpoint, MCP-specific auth flow), and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents can connect and use it.
